VBO:0201396.summary: Water dogs have distinct characters: the Barbet tends to be sociable and even-tempered, while the Portuguese Water Dog is intelligent, courageous and willing to work. Their histories include retrieving waterfowl and helping fishermen. The affectionate, keen-nosed Lagotto Romagnolo moved from marshland retrieving to truffle hunting.
VBO:0201396.shortDescription: From the sociable Barbet to the keen Lagotto, this varied family carries traditions of water work and scent-led searching.
